status: prospective; freeze source and protocol before measurement
scope: warmed synthetic TIFF/math recognition; separate from 46-case/four-capture baseline and whole-Tika evaluation
build: Same source commit, complete source/relink bundle, compiler/native archives, allocator and profiling settings. Only CARGO_PROFILE_PROFILING_LTO differs thin/fat. No release profile changed. Diagnostic result is not a production stripped-binary measurement.
parity: Every measured output must byte-match its frozen reference; input, expected bytes, models, binary and source admitted before use. All failures retained; no silent retries, replacement cells, trimming, or default selection on partial data.
measurement: Fresh process/container per arm; warmup all sessions and fixture. Latency excludes per-request stats writes and reference comparison. Phase cgroup CPU/memory includes startup, model verification, warmup, reference checks and teardown. File cache already warmed, attribution caveats unchanged.
analysis: Four process pairs are descriptive replicates. Preserve all 32 latencies, stage/padding/batch metrics, process median/p95, paired median and p95 ratios, resource counters and order. No request-level independent confidence interval or population generalization.

default_policy.rule: Retain baseline unless every pair in every CPU/fixture has candidate/baseline median <=0.95, p95 <=1.05 and phase peak memory <=1.10, all parity/resource/native gates pass. Report tradeoffs and neutral/regressive results; this conservative fixture policy does not establish corpus-wide defaults.

exclusions: No exporter/telemetry sampling ablation: diagnostic OCR has no exporter; requires separate HTTP/receiver protocol.
No hardware-counter/ISA causal claim from CPU-clock sampling.
